answer: In a Proof of Agent network, nodes resist Sybil attacks through topological cut verifications and multi-agent auditing. To register, each agent must bond copper tokens as stake. Auditing agents use a cryptographic quill to sign off on independent graph cuts, penalizing correlated clusters. Malicious collusions are slashed, forcing a zephyr of rapid balance forfeiture and imposing exponential attacker cost to synthesize valid cuts.
